blocks.body:
## The contribution turns negative search evidence into reusable quality control

This modular framework validates TIFFXYZ geometry, public-m7 sheet support, full normal-offset sampling, raw-depth evidence, model consensus, exact surface novelty, and provenance before a candidate can advance. Demonstrated across all 13 eligible scrolls, it found no defensible text candidate—but exposed failure modes that otherwise create plausible surfaces, false glyphs, and repeated GPU work.

## Four scrolls reached raw review; none produced defensible text

The 0.5 cm² threshold was a precommitted cost-control gate, not a prize rule. Scrolls below it stopped before raw rendering; scrolls above it underwent independent depth and artifact review.

## PHerc0813 proved that proposal area can grow while valid evidence plateaus

A clean 93-layer raw stack and six model-independent candidate regions all failed depth review. Extending GrowPatch from generation 40 to 80 then increased whole proposal area nearly fivefold, but accepted geometry stopped changing after generation 60.

## Independent controls catch failures that visual plausibility misses

The framework treats attractive output as a nomination, not a pass. Each failure below was observed on public Vesuvius data and changed the campaign's decisions or implementation.

## A pinned canonical model failed the order-stability gate

On PHerc1203, physically scale-matched forward and reverse ResNet-152 maps both passed integrity and coverage checks but had Pearson correlation **0.032425**, top-1% Jaccard **0.003361**, and zero overlap in the top 0.5%. Fixed raw review found zero defensible or borderline text candidates, so shifted-origin inference was skipped. This is a negative sensitivity result for a 2 µm checkpoint applied to 9.362 µm data—not evidence that the scroll contains no writing.

## Near-perfect fit still failed 1.228 mm away

A three-seed same-scroll experiment reached train-A AUROC **0.99595 ± 0.00344** but local-B AUROC only **0.51207 ± 0.05094** and AP **0.27209 ± 0.01882** at prevalence **0.26490**. Zero seeds passed the precommitted train-plus-local gate, so distant-C remained sealed. The result closes decoder retuning and target-domain SSL on the same coarse representation—not the possibility that new physical data can reveal ink.

## The release directly matches the current Progress Prize criteria

The official rules favor real-data improvements, actionable analytic tools, standard community formats, modular integration, early open source, and thorough documentation. This release supplies command-line tools, 129 portable synthetic tests, compact hash-bound demonstrations, usage guides, and an MIT license. The next stated deadline is **August 31, 2026 at 11:59pm Pacific**.

## Scope and limitations

The 13-scroll stopping decision is conditional on public assets and methods available through August 12, 2026. Public-m7 is a geometry cue, manual review is not papyrological proof, and a conservative raw audit can miss weak ink. The framework intentionally reports **not established** rather than converting missing evidence into a pass. Reopen the First Letters search only for a materially new scan or prediction, an independent expert-corrected sheet, or raw strokes that survive depth and artifact controls.

## Recommended community use

Run the toolkit as a quality layer before expensive inference: inventory first, validate stored geometry and selected-sheet support, reload and revalidate the exact serialized full-resolution surface, inspect raw evidence across depth, preserve orientation contradictions, and measure exact accepted-surface novelty before growing farther. This makes future unwrapping work faster, safer, and easier to reproduce.
